lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the pectoral fin insertion. The spots are organized into approximately five observable horizontal rows with consistent inter-centroid spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct curvilinear white mark and a corresponding irregular notch are visible on the distal trailing edge of the right pectoral fin.
